query SearchRecipes($query: String!, $first: Int, $after: String, $diets: [Diet!], $intolerances: [Intolerance!], $maxReadyTime: Int) {
  searchRecipes(
    query: $query
    first: $first
    after: $after
    filters: {diets: $diets, intolerances: $intolerances, maxReadyTime: $maxReadyTime}
  ) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        name
        imageUrl
        servings
        totalTimeMinutes
        externalSource
        externalId
        isSaved

        __typename

      __typename
    }
    totalCount
    __typename
  }
}
